places.name: The Iron Bridge & Ironbridge Gorge
places.description: UNESCO World Heritage landscape centred on the Iron Bridge, museums and industrial heritage sites in the Severn Gorge.

places.name: Telford Town Park Amphitheatre
places.address: Telford Town Park, near St Quentin Gate / International Centre, Telford, TF3 4EH
places.description: Restored outdoor amphitheatre in Telford Town Park hosting live music, theatre, comedy and family entertainment as part of Telford Theatre on Tour.

places.name: Telford Ice Rink & Soft Play
places.description: Indoor ice rink with general skating and relaxed family skating sessions, plus soft play and family facilities.
places.opening_hours: Session times vary; check the official timetable and booking page for the chosen date.
places.accessibility: Structured local listing reports wheelchair-accessible parking, entrance, seating and toilet facilities; confirm any specific access needs with the venue before travel.

places.name: The Quarry Park
places.description: Historic riverside park in central Shrewsbury and major festival venue, hosting events such as Shrewsbury Food Festival and Shropshire Oktoberfest.
places.opening_hours: Open to the public 24 hours a day, throughout the year, including most public holidays.

places.name: Carding Mill Valley & the Long Mynd
places.description: National Trust countryside in the Shropshire Hills with walking routes, valley scenery and access to the Long Mynd.
places.age_guidance: All ages; walking ability varies by route

places.name: QEII Arena
places.address: Hinkshay Road, Telford Town Park, Telford, TF3 4EH
places.description: Large outdoor events arena within Telford Town Park, used for major public events including the Telford Balloon Fiesta Night Glow.

places.name: Telford Theatre
places.description: Theatre and live entertainment venue serving Telford and the wider Shropshire area.

places.name: Hoo Zoo and Dinosaur World
places.address: Hoo Farm, Hoo, Telford, Shropshire, TF6 6DJ
places.description: Family-run zoo and dinosaur attraction outside Telford with animals, dinosaur areas, play spaces, daily activities and seasonal events.
places.opening_hours: Opening hours vary by season; check the official website/app for the current day.
places.accessibility: Relatively flat site. Gravel paths can be difficult for some wheelchair users. Limited disabled parking and disabled toilets are available. Access Card requirements apply to some concessions and carer tickets.
places.parking_transport: Official directions recommend Humber Lane for sat-nav; brown signs are provided from M54 J6, A442 Shawbirch and A518 Donnington. Limited disabled parking is available.

places.name: Dale End Park
places.address: Dale End, Ironbridge, Telford, Shropshire, TF8 7EG
places.description: Riverside park and event space in Ironbridge Gorge used for festivals, community events and World Heritage celebrations.

places.name: Telford Town Park
places.description: Large award-winning town park with play areas, nature reserve, trails, sensory gardens, visitor centre, bandstand, amphitheatre and QEII events arena.
places.parking_transport: Nearby parking includes Southwater Multi-Storey, Dark Lane and Brown Elm. Disabled bays are available in nearby car parks. Rail and bus links serve Telford town centre.

places.name: Shrewsbury town centre
places.description: Historic county town with independent shops, food, riverside walks and heritage attractions.

places.name: Ludlow Castle
places.description: Historic castle and event venue in central Ludlow, including the annual Ludlow Food Festival.

places.name: Apley Farm Shop, Playbarn & Nature Trail
places.address: Apley Farm Shop, Stockton Buildings, Norton, Shropshire, TF11 9EF
places.description: Farm shop destination with café, Playbarn, outdoor play, nature trail, dog walking and a regular family events calendar.
places.opening_hours: Hours vary by activity; check the official Apley website before travel.
places.parking_transport: Free on-site parking. Apley states that electric vehicle charging points are available.
